_meta.source: encount.txt + group1.txt + enemy1.txt + enemybase1.txt + enemyexptbl.h + enemy.c + battle.c + char.c + setup.cf
_meta.parserNote: enemybase integer fields use atoi(); enemy1 ENEMY_ITEM1..10 / ITEMPROB1..10 are preserved as 10-slot integer arrays; encount x1/y1/x2/y2 are normalized with min/max exactly like ENCOUNT_initEncount()
_meta.enemyCreateRule: base V/S/T/D += RAND(0,4)-2 individually; then 10 points each RAND(0,3); PARAM=(level-1)*atoi(LVUPPOINT)+INITNUM
_meta.enemyDropRule: _FIX_ITEMPROB: each of 10 slots independently uses RAND(0,999) < ITEMPROB at ENEMY_createEnemy(); successful items are carried by the Enemy, then BATTLE_GetExpGold() distributes defeated-enemy loot through 3 result slots per player
_meta.enemyExpRule: if ENEMY_DUELPOINT<=0: ENEMY_EXP!=-1 uses override; otherwise enemybaseexptbl[level-1] + (rankBonus + alpha)*level, truncated to int and min 1
_meta.battleExpRule: BATTLE_AddExpItem: recipientLevel-enemyLevel<=5 gets full Enemy EXP; higher levels use max(1, EXP*(20-diff)/15) with integer truncation; BATTLE_GetExp then applies setup.cf battleexp multiplier

randomChange.humanRule: random gym body; random opposed 4-elements; random dojo weapon; skill slots 0/1 are normal attack for fist/bow/boomerang/boundthrow/breakthrow, otherwise random EnemyGymSkill
randomChange.conditionalGymSkills: additional EnemyGymSkill entries depend on compile-time feature flags; runtime records rule but does not pretend a fixed expanded pool
